doctrines.note: Veterancy: everything works, but start by Top Line. Playstyle kit: as any lancer cav, the goal is enough charge time to load the long-charge trait — get to max speed before impact. Use the rune (if still available in future seasons) that makes the lancer-cav trait change every 0.5s instead of 1.5s, loading the long-charge trait much faster. Once at max speed (similar to Xuanjia but far less pronounced), X-move to a side and the unit retains enough momentum for huge damage. No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle notes (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Don't put' is filled with 'Hero DMG' per OP (unlike most other guides in this batch where it's a literal X placeholder). Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; Yeomen is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.

steps.text: As any lancer cavalry, the goal is to have enough charge time to load the long-charge trait — get to max speed before impact.
Use the rune (if still available) that makes the lancer-cav trait change every 0.5s instead of 1.5s, so the long-charge trait loads much faster.
Once at max speed (kinda like Xuanjia, but way less), X-move to a side and the unit will still have enough momentum for huge damage.
